ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are upper, middle, and lower nodes. In the upper half, on the left is a current source labeled IS1=3 A with an upward arrow, and on the right is R1=3Ω; the two are connected in parallel between the upper node and the middle node. In the lower half, on the left is a current source labeled IS2=5 A with a downward arrow, and on the right is R2=2Ω; the two are connected in parallel between the middle node and the lower node. The final port is the topmost terminal and the bottommost terminal. Reasoning: According to the method specified in the problem, convert the upper Norton equivalent into a Thevenin voltage source, with voltage IS1×R1=3×3=9 V; convert the lower Norton equivalent into a Thevenin voltage source, with voltage IS2×R2=5×2=10 V. From the arrow directions of the two current sources, these two equivalent voltage sources have opposite polarities as seen from the final upper and lower port, so the total equivalent voltage takes the algebraic difference: 10 V−9 V=1 V. In one-decimal format it is 1.0 V.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the upper Norton pair as IS1 = 3 A in parallel with R1 = 3 Ω and the lower Norton pair as IS2 = 5 A in parallel with R2 = 2 Ω, stacked between the same top-middle-bottom nodes. Convert the upper pair to a 3×3 = 9 V Thevenin source and the lower pair to a 5×2 = 10 V Thevenin source. Determine from the arrows that these two equivalent voltage sources have opposite polarities when viewed across the final top and bottom terminals, so the net equivalent voltage is the algebraic difference 10 V − 9 V = 1 V. Report it in the requested one-decimal format as 1.0 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有上、中、下三个节点。上半部分在左侧是标注 IS1=3 A、箭头向上的电流源，右侧是 R1=3Ω，二者并联在上节点和中节点之间。下半部分在左侧是标注 IS2=5 A、箭头向下的电流源，右侧是 R2=2Ω，二者并联在中节点和下节点之间。最终端口为最上端和最下端。推理：按题设方法，将上方 Norton 等效为 Thevenin 电压源，电压为 IS1×R1=3×3=9 V；将下方 Norton 等效为 Thevenin 电压源，电压为 IS2×R2=5×2=10 V。由两个电流源箭头方向可知，这两个等效电压源从最终上下端口看极性相反，因此总等效电压取代数差：10 V−9 V=1 V。按一位小数格式为 1.0 V。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct source-transformation route: it treats each current-source/resistor pair as a Norton equivalent and combines the resulting two Thevenin voltage sources. With target count 1, no alternative route is needed.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit as two stacked sections sharing a middle node: upper section has a 3 A current source directed upward in parallel with R1 = 3 Ω between the top and middle nodes; lower section has a 5 A current source directed downward in parallel with R2 = 2 Ω between the middle and bottom nodes. The output terminals are the top and bottom right wires.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt only to know the requested quantity: the final equivalent voltage source, in volts, reported as a floating-point number with one decimal place.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use Norton-to-Thevenin conversion: a current source I in parallel with resistor R is equivalent to a voltage source V = I R in series with R, with polarity determined by the source direction. Then add series voltage sources algebraically, subtracting if their polarities oppose across the final top-to-bottom terminals.
